title: world3 region request
description: Declarative config that the world3 orchestrator (world3_make.py, Phase E.3) consumes to produce a world-data bundle. One config -> one bundle, deterministic, reproducible. The schema is rooted in real existing manifest shapes (build_world.py meta.json, build_opentopo_textured_master_stack.py stack_manifest.json, build_procedural_neighbor_bundle.py meta.json) so requests describe real pipeline behavior, not aspirational behavior.

schema_version.description: Bumps when the schema changes incompatibly. Orchestrator rejects requests with unknown versions.

id.description: Stable lowercase identifier for this bundle. Used as the output directory name and as the gate manifest key.

description.description: Optional human-readable description (for run.json provenance only; not used by stages).

source.description: Where the heightmap and (optionally) source orthophoto come from.

dem.description: Path to source DEM GeoTIFF. Absolute or relative to repo root (D:/assets).

orthophoto.description: Optional path to source RGB orthophoto GeoTIFF aligned to the DEM (or coarsely overlapping; the build script reprojects).

crop.description: Optional crop window inside the DEM. Mirrors build_opentopo_textured_master_stack.py args.

bbox.description: [left, bottom, right, top] in source CRS

fill_distance_px.description: Max search distance for DEM no-data fill (rasterio fillnodata).

review_max_dim.description: Max edge length of the Godot review heightmap PNG.

oneOf.description: Procedural neighbor (Chain 3). Heightmap synthesized from catalog material rules.

material_id.description: Catalog material id to use as procedural seed (e.g. desert_canyon_rock, alpine_granite). Must exist in world3/materials/catalog.json.

size_px.description: [width, height] of the procedural heightmap PNG.

world_size_m.description: [width, height] in meters of the procedural world region.

neighbor_west_edge.description: F.3.1: optional repo-relative path to the west neighbor's east_edge.json so this bundle's western column matches its neighbor's eastern column. Set by world_plan_to_bundles.py iterator.

neighbor_north_edge.description: F.3.1: optional repo-relative path to the north neighbor's south_edge.json so this bundle's top row matches its neighbor's bottom row. Set by world_plan_to_bundles.py iterator.

neighbor_edge_feather_px.description: F.3.1: feather distance (pixels) for inward blend of neighbor edge constraints.

this_biome.description: F.3.2: this bundle's biome id (matches plan.biomes[].id). Used by the procedural builder to decide whether east/south neighbors carry a different biome that needs splat crossfade.

neighbor_east_biome.description: F.3.2: east neighbor's biome id (or empty if same biome / no neighbor).

neighbor_south_biome.description: F.3.2: south neighbor's biome id (or empty if same biome / no neighbor).

neighbor_splat_feather_px.description: F.3.2: feather distance (pixels) for splat-weight boundary crossfade.

oneOf.description: Hybrid (real + procedural) seam-integration bundle (Chain 3 extended). Joins a real source region to a procedurally-generated neighbor.

real.description: Real source region reference. Either a bundle path (already-built) or a nested 'real' source spec (build first, then use).

bundle_path.description: Path to an existing real source bundle directory (must contain heightmap.png + meta.json).

crop_macro_px.description: [left, top, width, height] crop window in the real source's macro pixel space.

procedural.description: Procedural neighbor spec, same shape as type=procedural source above.

biome_kit.description: Biome kit id; must exist in world3/jobs/biome_kits.json (alpine, desert, tundra, temperate_forest, grassland, or any future addition).

style_pack.description: Style pack id; must match a file in world3/jobs/style_packs/<id>.json (validated against style_pack_schema.json). Applied at capture/render time by OrchestratorCaptureDriver.gd via run_orchestrator_capture.py --style-pack. Bundles themselves are style-pack-independent: the same bundle can be re-rendered in different styles without rebuild. Phase E.5 ships 'photoreal' as the default (reproduces World3AutoReviewTour.gd defaults byte-identically).

view_modes.description: Which per-mode .tres material variants to deploy. Phase E swaps per the per-mode tres system (Phase E shipped 2026-05-07).

water.description: Generate water layer (rivers, lakes, masks). Not yet implemented; reserved for future work.

weather.description: Generate weather layer (precipitation, clouds, etc.). Not yet implemented.

scatter_density.description: Scatter mask density preset (vegetation, rocks, debris). Used by M15 scatter pipeline.

render_captures.description: Run Godot capture scenes for each view mode after build completes.

promote_to_gate.description: Register this bundle in world3/jobs/production_promotion_candidates.json. Default false; the operator/user reviews captures first.

bundle_dir.description: Path to the output bundle directory (absolute or relative to repo root).

overwrite.description: Overwrite existing bundle if present. Default false (safer).
